provenance: output clip ported from pi packages/coding-agent/src/core/tools/truncate.ts (2000 lines / 50KB). On clip, full stdout+stderr spills to workspace .lab-out/<n>.txt. Subprocess timeout is LAB_TOOL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS from the runner (minus 3s) so exec can emit `exec: timed out after N s` (exit 124) before the runner's wall clock.
description: Run a command (argv array, no shell) in the workspace. Absolute paths and '..' in argv are denied. Host writes are denied: macOS sandbox-exec (file-write* only under cwd); Linux equivalent is `bwrap --ro-bind / / --bind $PWD $PWD --chdir $PWD` (bubblewrap). There is NO shell: `cd` and `&&` do not work as argv — for compound commands or subdirectories use {cmd: ["sh", "-c", "cd subdir && make test"]}. Args: {cmd: [...]}. Output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first); when clipped, the full output is written to .lab-out/<n>.txt and that path is named in the observation so it can be fs_read back.
